title: Chapter 117 Unsealed
content:
Chapter 117 Unsealed

"By the way, dad, my mother, why didn't I see her?"

At this time, Lu Xue said again.

"Uh, your mother, she's resting."

"rest?"

Lu Xue always feels something is wrong, but she just can't think of it.

Just as he was about to continue saying something, Gu Chen suddenly came slowly from a distance.

Seeing Gu Chen, Lu Xue hurriedly said, "Master, why are you here?"

Gu Chen smiled and said, "I'll see if you have any problems with your practice recently."

"Master Lord."

Lu Daosheng nodded.

"Problem? Master, I have no problem."

At this time, Lu Xue spoke.

Upon hearing this, Gu Chen shook his head, "Xiaoxue, maybe you can't feel it yourself, so on the safe side, let me practice."

"Emm, OK."

Then Lu Xue turned around and looked at Lu Daosheng, "Dad, then Master and I will go to practice."

"Okay, go."

Lu Daosheng said with a smile.

Immediately, Gu Chen took Lu Xue away.

Before leaving, Gu Chen smiled at Lu Daosheng.

Gu Chen was naturally called by Lu Daosheng.

Although I am a little sorry for Lu Xue, there is no way. Lu Daosheng obviously wants to be more intimate with his wife.

In the room, Yan Lingyun slowly stood up. As soon as she got off the bed, her legs became weak and she almost fell to the ground.

"Hiss~"

At this moment, she regretted saying that.

But there is nothing I can do. It took Lu Daosheng a long time since he touched a woman. After thinking about it, he blamed herself.

well.

Yan Lingyun sighed and walked out of the house with a slight pace.

Seeing Yan Lingyun, Lu Daosheng hurriedly walked to Yan Lingyun and supported her.

"Lingyun, why don't you take a little longer?"

Lu Daosheng cared about Dao.

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun gave him a blank look, snorted lightly, and said nothing.

I'm not like this because of you.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng just smiled.

These days, Lu Daosheng has lived a very comfortable life.

He hopes that this will be the case for the rest of his life, but it is obviously not realistic.

Unless Lu Daosheng doesn't care about anything now.

"Daosheng, why did you create the wasteland city?"

Lieing in Lu Daosheng's arms, Yan Lingyun suddenly looked up and asked.

The scale of this Huangcheng is not small now, and it has great potential. It is a bit redundant to create such a force with Lu Daosheng's ability.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng was a little dazed.

After a moment of silence, he slowly said, "People, you have to do something."

You can't do anything mediocre.

What's more, he doesn't need to practice, he is idle, and seeing the deserted city become stronger and stronger, he feels a sense of accomplishment from the bottom of his heart.

Hearing this answer, Yan Lingyun nodded, "Daosheng, in fact, I have my own things to do."

Suddenly, Lu Daosheng was stunned.

"Lingyun, you won't leave again, right?"

Lu Daosheng frowned.

Yan Lingyun smiled and said, "With your current strength, if you want to find me, isn't that going to happen in the blink of an eye?"

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng realized it.

It seems to be true.

"What should I do if Xiaoxue?"

Lu Daosheng asked.

"Let Xiaoxue follow me, I will always have to take some responsibility as a mother."

Yan Lingyun said directly.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng was silent.

It means separation?

Then I will become a lonely man.

Seeing Lu Daosheng silent, Yan Lingyun also guessed Lu Daosheng's thoughts and sighed. Yan Lingyun directly held Lu Daosheng's face and smiled and said, "Daosheng, why don't you go with me, I'll raise it. you."

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled.

"Forget it, Lingyun, you have your own things to do, and I have them for your husband, but I just hope that you don't show off. When encountering things that cannot be solved, you must call me, do you know?"

Looking at Lu Daosheng's sincere eyes, Yan Lingyun only felt warm in her heart.

"Okay, I remember."

Finally, Yan Lingyun left and pulled Lu Xue away from the Xuanling Star Domain.

"Dad, I'm leaving. I'll see me when I have time!"

Lu Xue turned around and waved to Lu Daosheng.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "Xiaoxue, follow your mother well and don't make your mother angry."

Standing at the border of Xuanling Star Domain, Lu Daosheng quietly looked at the direction where his mother and mother left. After a long time, Lu Daosheng suddenly shook his head and smiled.

What are you feeling about?

It's not that I'm not coming back.

Immediately, Lu Daosheng turned around and returned to the deserted city.

Next, Lu Daosheng began to work diligently, and improved his strength for Huang Shou, An Xing and others.

The progress has accelerated a lot.

No matter how you want to catch up with your wife's power.

As far as he knows, his wife has established a huge force in a certain star field, which seems to be quite famous.

However, although it seems extremely powerful and no one dares to provoke him, there is definitely a stronger existence in the secret and he is eyeing his wife's power.

Otherwise, why did Yan Lingyun go back so early?

Lu Daosheng has already made speculations about this.

And with her wife's personality, if she takes direct action to solve the problem, she will definitely not do it.

Therefore, it is better to improve your strength in the deserted city and be the person behind the scenes.

.........

I don't know how long it took.

On this day, Lu Daosheng suddenly set off and arrived at the boundary of the Xuanling Star Domain.

Now Xuanling Star Domain, Qingling Star Domain, Wuling Star Domain and some other nearby star domains have all been unified.

Huangcheng is even more prosperous.

This first step has been completed.

Then, Lu Daosheng used his great magical power and smashed all the obstacles between the star domains with one blow.

Accompanied by the terrifying explosion.

The connection between these star domains suddenly became closer.

And Huangcheng is undoubtedly the absolute overlord of these star domains. At the command, all spirits come to pay homage.

"Lord City Lord, we are ready."

Jiangbei and Yu Qingfeng came to Lu Daosheng and said respectfully.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng nodded.

These days, Huangcheng's strength has grown to an extremely terrifying level. Looking at all the surrounding star domains, it seems to be invincible.

Next, their goal is to focus on those truly powerful top star domains.

In front of him was the barrier that Yan Lingyun had left behind, which was to protect this star field.

But now, it is no longer needed.

"Break."

Lu Daosheng spoke slowly.

In an instant, the entire barrier was completely broken.

After many years, this star field was once again exposed to the eyes of the world.

Countless star fields noticed the movement and sent people to check it out.

"My lord, that star field is alive."

"Alive?"

"Yes, the barrier there has disappeared for some reason."

Hearing this, the person above in the hall was immediately excited and said, "Send someone there immediately, don't let others get there first."

Over the years, due to the blockade of the Xuanling Star Field, the outside world suddenly spread the news that a mysterious treasure appeared there. This news immediately attracted countless people from major forces to want to go in and find out.

But facing the hazy barrier, everyone was powerless.

But the more this happened, the more people believed in the news that there was a treasure there.

Now, the barrier has disappeared.

They can finally find out what happened.

However, they dare not be careless, because some time ago, the terrifying force that fell from the sky was aimed at that place.

And not only was there nothing wrong there, but there was an extremely terrifying aura.

Some people speculated that there was a peerless strongman hiding there.

Some people also speculated that it was because of the treasure.

But the real reason can only be known by going in.

"Master, should we send someone there?"

An elder in a top sect asked.

Hearing this, the master said expressionlessly: "Let's take a look first, don't forget, there are two God Emperors there."

Hearing this, the elder was shocked.

I forgot it if I didn't say it.

Two God Emperors, this kind of strength is definitely not weak.

As far as he knows, there seems to be no God Emperor in the entire sect.
